inv.desc_es:
Grupo Portugal. Traspaso de local de hostelería con licencia de bar restaurante ubicado en el barrio de Valdeacederas en el distrito de Tetuán, en Madrid. Zona residencial, comercial y empresarial con diversos comercios, con afluencia de público y rodado y con buenas comunicaciones. El local tiene una superficie de 179 m² distribuidos en una planta, dividido en dos aseos adaptados para personas con movilidad reducida, almacén y cocina completamente equipada con salida de humos. Dispone de fachada de 15 metros lineales acristalados que aporta gran luminosidad al local, con dos terraza de uso privado una acristalada y otra abierta. Aforo interno de 167 personas. 

ref: 4106.
inv.desc_en:
Grupo Portugal. Transfer of a hospitality venue with a bar-restaurant license located in the Valdeacederas neighborhood in the Tetuán district, in Madrid. Residential, commercial, and business area with various shops, with public and vehicular traffic and good transport links. The venue has a surface area of 179 m² distributed on one floor, divided into two restrooms adapted for people with reduced mobility, a storage room, and a fully equipped kitchen with a smoke outlet. It has a 15-linear meter glazed facade that provides great luminosity to the venue, with two private terraces, one glazed and one open. Internal capacity of 167 people.

ref: 4106.
